headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 26, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a thrilling 2-1 victory over the Chicago Cubs, while the Baltimore Orioles dominated the Tampa Bay Rays in a 7-9 showdown. The Washington Nationals took down the Cleveland Guardians 6-3, and the Milwaukee Brewers edged out the St. Louis Cardinals 5-1.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with the New York Mets transferring Luis Robert Jr. to the 60-day injured list due to a lumbar spine disc herniation. The Athletics placed Aaron Civale on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder tendinitis and Denzel Clarke on the 60-day injured list with a mid foot bone bruise in his right foot. The Chicago White Sox placed Noah Schultz on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 25, 2026, with right knee patellar tendinitis. The Milwaukee Brewers placed Logan Henderson on the 15-day injured list retroactive to May 23, 2026, with a low back strain. The Tampa Bay Rays placed Jesse Scholtens on the 15-day injured list with a right wrist sprain, and the New York Mets placed Tyrone Taylor on the 10-day injured list with a right hip flexor strain. The Colorado Rockies placed Jose Quintana on the 15-day injured list with a left elbow sprain.

Several trades and roster movements took place, including the Colorado Rockies trading LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash, the Philadelphia Phillies trading RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations, and the Cincinnati Reds trading RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Cubs in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Chicago Cubs 2-1, securing their win behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Michael Busch led the Cubs' offense with a home run and an RBI, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Pirates' defense.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Orioles in Thrilling 7-9 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-9 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, handing the Rays their loss. Jonathan Aranda led the Rays' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins dropped a 1-3 decision to the Chicago White Sox, with Drew Romo leading the Twins' offense. Romo hit a home run and drove in two runs, while Anthony Kay earned the win with 6.0 innings pitched, striking out 5 and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Brewers in 5-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals were defeated by the Milwaukee Brewers with a final score of 5-1. Christian Yelich led the Brewers' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Guardians 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 6-3 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with James Wood and Keibert Ruiz leading the charge offensively. Cade Cavalli was instrumental in the win, pitching effectively for the Nationals.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer Shutout Loss to Orioles**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, winning 6-1 in the matchup. Shane Baz was the only Rays pitcher to make an impact in the game.

top_news.title: **Luis Robert Jr. Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: New York Mets center fielder Luis Robert Jr. has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a lumbar spine disc herniation.

top_news.title: **Rockies Make Roster Move Ahead of Series**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies traded left-handed pitcher Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals in exchange for cash on May 25, 2026.
